purpose: Re-measure price qualification on the current default after the market declared its 2.5 MVAr reactive asset at buses 17, 31 and 32.

sample.rule: Six of each of the two failure classes, taken at even spacing over the date-sorted class; all four class-c days are taken because the declared asset is expected to move them.

recorded: dispatch optimal flag and solver status
conditional price solve optimal flag and solver status
every probe: period, bus, epsilon, dual, left and right derivative, smooth_pass, subgradient_bracket
acceptance: Unchanged. This run measures and does not widen any criterion. A day whose conditional solve is suboptimal keeps that status unless a solver setting reaches an optimal solve with the objective agreement preserved.
